title: The Healthcare Ops Bottleneck AI Is Finally Ready to Solve
existing_summary: Breaking why healthcare ops still needs armies moving info across portals, PDFs, phones, EHRs—and how Champ AI automates the messy middle where work between systems is stubbornly manual.
summary_bullets: Healthcare operations depend on people manually coordinating work between fragmented systems, creating a staffing bottleneck that scales poorly
Champ AI automates cross-system workflows by reading documents, navigating portals, making phone calls, and updating internal systems under one coordinated process
The platform includes human-in-the-loop review, audit trails, and self-healing browser agents to handle edge cases and maintain control in high-stakes healthcare operations
Moving staff from routine coordination to exception review allows organizations to scale volume without proportional labor cost increases
